claim: Formulate risk-aware decisions from natural-language delegation with retained decision-relevant alternatives and no further user interaction
object: State-wise interpretations/events, requirements, consequences, risk permissions and utility; Equations (1)-(4)
evidence: Section 3.1; fixed-set decision principle attributed to RAC
scope: Faithful decision-relevant representation is the condition for decision analysis, not an assumption of uniquely resolved intent; no new max-min theorem or conformal calibration claim

claim: Provide an ambiguity-preserving state-wise representation and fixed executable risk/value decision framework
object: Predefined language/interface and aggregation; model-generated per-request hard/risk/utility; fixed evaluator in Algorithm 1
evidence: vendor/engine.py; runtime.py; algorithm_code_alignment.json; algorithm_contract_check.json (10 local checks)
scope: Exact optimization requires complete catalogue coverage, decided admissibility for every candidate, and known utilities for every admissible candidate. Algorithm 1 returns Fail(uncertified) before selection otherwise. Historical outcome accuracy is separate from optimality or infeasibility certification.
